editorial.blurb: This wife-and-husband-run Korean gem delivers exceptional, deeply satisfying dishes at prices that feel like a gift.
editorial.insiderTip: Grab the lunch special seolleongtang for $9.99—an incredible value that regulars swear by, and arrive early on cold days when the rich, comforting broth hits differently.
signatureDishes: Ssyal Samgye Tang (whole cornish hen soup)
Jjim Dak (braised chicken with glass noodles)
